top_signals.title: PNJ Taps Chairwoman’s Family for Loan After Diamond Scandal
top_signals.summary: Phu Nhuan Jewelry JSC, Vietnam’s largest listed jeweler known as PNJ, is securing a loan from the family of Chairwoman Cao Thi Ngoc Dung to rebuild its business after a national diamond-smuggling scandal battered the industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
